name: Stagecoach South Lateral

values.StartLocation: Tennessee Gas Pipeline Station 319, Susquehanna County
values.Owner: Central New York Oil and Gas

researcher_notes: Not in the roster: the Tennessee Gas Pipeline row P0259 is a whole-system row, and no lateral row exists. The 2000 Federal Register notice for FERC docket CP00-65 describes about 23.7 miles of 30 inch lateral from Tennessee station 319 in Susquehanna County, Pennsylvania north to the Stagecoach storage field in Tioga County, New York. The consolidator note said Bradford County, but the notice says Susquehanna County, so the start is recorded that way. Gas Intelligence reported the lateral in service in January 2002 and its later sale to Central New York Oil and Gas with FERC approval. The EIA August 2026 release, Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 242 (project name Tenneco Stagecoach Lateral), states 24 miles, diameter 24 and 30 inches, 487 MMcf/d, completed 2002. The 24 inch figure probably refers to the replacement pipe on the 300 Line and is not used. The EIA row 425 named Stagecoach South Lateral is a different, shorter pipe (6 miles, 20 inch, docket CP06-64) and is not this record; the consolidator note conflated them. Length is 23.7 miles, above the 15.5 mile floor. The current owner may have changed since the sale and was not checked. No official route data found; route not researched. Two independent origins (FERC notice, trade press) plus EIA; one origin each. Owner name not found in the gazetteer; style unconfirmed.
